ltrim.description: [fn] Returns the original string with leading whitespace removed.

max.description: [fn] Returns the maximum value in a set of values.

min.description: [fn] Returns the minimum value in a set of values.

nodes.description: [fn] Returns a list containing all the nodes in a path.

none.description: [fn] Returns true if the predicate holds for no element in the given list.

percentileCont.description: [fn] Returns the percentile of a value over a group using linear interpolation.

percentileDisc.description: [fn] Returns the nearest integer value to the given percentile over a group using a rounding method.

point.description: [fn] Returns a 2D or 3D point object, given two or respectively three coordinate values in the Cartesian coordinate system or WGS 84 geographic coordinate system.

point.distance.description: [fn] Returns a floating point number representing the geodesic distance between any two points in the same CRS.

point.withinBBox.description: [fn] Returns true if the provided point is within the bounding box defined by the two provided points.

properties.description: [fn] Returns a map containing all the properties of a node.

rand.description: [fn] Returns a random floating point number in the range from 0 (inclusive) to 1 (exclusive); i.e. [0,1).

range.description: [fn] Returns a list comprising all integer values within a specified range.

reduce.description: [fn] Runs an expression against individual elements of a list, storing the result of the expression in an accumulator.

relationships.description: [fn] Returns a list containing all the relationships in a path.

replace.description: [fn] Returns a string in which all occurrences of a specified search string in the original string have been replaced by another (specified) replace string.

reverse.description: [fn] Returns a string in which the order of all characters in the original string have been reversed.

right.description: [fn] Returns a string containing the specified number of rightmost characters of the original string.

round.description: [fn] Returns the value of a number rounded to the nearest integer.

rtrim.description: [fn] Returns the original string with trailing whitespace removed.

sign.description: [fn] Returns the signum of an integer number: 0 if the number is 0, -1 for any negative number, and 1 for any positive number.

sin.description: [fn] Returns the sine of a number.

single.description: [fn] Returns true if the predicate holds for exactly one of the elements in the given list.

size.description: [fn] Returns the number of items in a list.

split.description: [fn] Returns a list of strings resulting from the splitting of the original string around matches of the given delimiter.

sqrt.description: [fn] Returns the square root of a number.

startNode.description: [fn] Returns the start node of a relationship.

stdev.description: [fn] Returns the standard deviation for the given value over a group for a sample of a population.

stdevp.description: [fn] Returns the standard deviation for the given value over a group for an entire population.

substring.description: [fn] Returns a substring of the original string, beginning with a 0-based index start.

sum.description: [fn] Returns the sum of a set of integers

tail.description: [fn] Returns all but the first element in a list.

tan.description: [fn] Returns the tangent of a number.

time.realtime.description: [fn] Get the current Time instant using the realtime clock.

time.statement.description: [fn] Get the current Time instant using the statement clock.

time.transaction.description: [fn] Get the current Time instant using the transaction clock.

time.truncate.description: [fn] Truncate the input temporal value to a Time instant using the specified unit.

toBooleanList.description: [fn] Converts a list of values to a list of boolean values. If any values are not convertible to boolean they will be null in the list returned.

toBooleanOrNull.description: [fn] Converts a value to a boolean value, or null if the value cannot be converted.

toFloat.description: [fn] Converts a string value to a floating point value.

toFloatList.description: [fn] Converts a list of values to a list of float values. If any values are not convertible to float they will be null in the list returned.

toFloatOrNull.description: [fn] Converts a value to a floating point value, or null if the value cannot be converted.

toInteger.description: [fn] Converts a string value to an integer value.

toIntegerList.description: [fn] Converts a list of values to a list of integer values. If any values are not convertible to integer they will be null in the list returned.

toIntegerOrNull.description: [fn] Converts a value to an integer value, or null if the value cannot be converted.

toLower.description: [fn] Returns the original string in lowercase.

toString.description: [fn] Converts an integer, float, boolean, point or temporal type (i.e. Date, Time, LocalTime, DateTime, LocalDateTime or Duration) value to a string.

toStringList.description: [fn] Converts a list of values to a list of string values. If any values are not convertible to string they will be null in the list returned.

toUpper.description: [fn] Returns the original string in uppercase.

trim.description: [fn] Returns the original string with leading and trailing whitespace removed.

type.description: [fn] Returns the string representation of the relationship type.
